content:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 1765554321 — Elevated 5xx / gateway timeouts on /generate and /embed (us-west-2). Pager: @lena-sre. Impact: multiple customers experiencing SDK timeouts. Suspected: KV/prefix cache degradation on shard pfx-42. Severity: P1->P2 candidate.

lena-sre: Ack. Oncall here. Seeing a 10x spike in 502/504s from gateway between 06:09-06:18 UTC. Rolling averages show prefix-cache hitrate collapse.

arjun-eng: Looking now. Any recent deploys to cache workers? I see a canary for prefix-cache-worker v2.3.1 rolled at 06:07.

maya-ml: CS reports real customers with timeouts on stream generation. Which shard is hot?

lena-sre: Metrics: pfx-42 hitrate dropped 92% -> 18%. KV read p95 for that shard jumped to ~1.2s. Logs show repeated entries: `prefix_checksum_mismatch: expected=0x1f4a got=0x0` and `kv_read_timeout: backend_sync`

arjun-eng: That looks like checksum corruption introduced during compaction/writeback. Immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) enable bypass to backing-store for pfx-42, 2) disable prefetch/writeback on that shard, 3) drain and restart cache-daemons for pfx-42.

dave-sre: Agreed. Can we flip a flag at the router level to reduce 5xx and stop thundering writes? We have a routed flag `cache_bypass` per-prefix.

ops-bot: Executing flag change: `/ops/flags set cache_bypass pfx-42 true` -> OK (propagated).

lena-sre: Flag applied. Please confirm traffic is now taking backing-store path (higher latency but fewer 5xx).

arjun-eng: From gateway terminal: `curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -o /dev/null https://gw.us-west-2.internal/generate?shard=pfx-42` previously returned 502; now returns 200 but p95 latency ~600ms. Logs: "fallback_read_taken=true" stamped in request trace. Error rate down from 18% -> 2.1% in the last 2 mins.

maya-ml: CS update?

customer-success: Notified affected customers (A & B). They saw 5xx/timeouts for ~7-12 minutes. We've opened tickets and posted the mitigation note: "We have activated a fallback to persistent store and are repairing the cache shard; more updates in 30m."

lena-sre: Initiating rolling restart on pfx-42 cache nodes: `for h in pfx-42-0 pfx-42-1 pfx-42-2 pfx-42-3; do ssh $h 'sudo systemctl restart cache-daemon' || echo restart-failed $h; done`

dar-win: (ops) restart kicked off, node 2 restarted clean. Node 3 shows repeated startup checks failing with checksum error.

dar-win: Logs excerpt: ```
[06:12:09] cache-daemon[pid]: validating prefix file header
[06:12:09] cache-daemon[pid]: prefix_checksum_mismatch: expected=0x1f4a got=0x00 at offset 0x4b2f
[06:12:09] cache-daemon[pid]: failing startup -- marking node degraded
```

arjun-eng: I'll inspect problematic node. Running `kvctl inspect pfx-42 node-3 --headers` shows corrupted blob entries. Hypothesis: compaction job at 06:09 concurrently wrote and didn't complete atomic swap.

dave-sre: Node-3 is still receiving occasional coordination messages; remove from ring so it stops impacting traffic: `kvctl ring remove node-3 --decommission`

arjun-eng: Removing node-3 from ring now. Traffic redistributed across remaining nodes. Error rate continues to decline to <1.5x baseline.

maya-ml: Any plan to repair corrupted data on node-3? We should rehydrate from replicas to avoid data loss.

arjun-eng: Kicking off `kvctl repair pfx-42 --target node-3 --from-replicas`. This will pull canonical blobs from healthy replicas and rewrite with validated checksum.

dar-win: Repair started. Progress: 0 -> 18% in 4 mins. ETA ~12 min.

incident-bot: Suggesting severity downgrade to SEV-3 as error rates are falling but keep monitoring for recurrence.

lena-sre: I agree with downgrade to SEV-3. Keeping oncall active for 1 hour. Postmortem required.

arjun-eng: Root cause hypothesis: compaction edge-case in v2.3.1 allowed a write path to proceed without final checksum validation, leading to invalid prefix blocks on one shard. Fix plan: add atomic rename + pre-write checksum verification + compaction fencing. I'll open PR and run canary in staging.

dave-sre: Node-3 repair completed. Final verification shows `prefix_checksum_mismatch` count = 0 and heal audits green. Re-added node-3 to ring: `kvctl ring add node-3`.

maya-ml: Created a new alert: `prefix_checksum_mismatch > 0` and a dashboard panel for prefix-hit-rate sudden drops. Also added an eval to run compaction dry-run on staging.

customer-success: Affected customers updated: mitigation in place, expected full restoration within 30m, postmortem forthcoming.

arjun-eng: Opening PR #8127 with fix, unit tests, and a small migration check. Planning staggered rollout with compaction gating for next deploy.

lena-sre: Oncall handoff: I will handoff to @dave-sre in 10m for the next 4h. Dave, you have the runbook and commands in `#runbooks/cache`.

dave-sre: Taking handoff. Will monitor repair and the `prefix_checksum_mismatch` metric. If anomaly reappears, will re-escalate to eng.

incident-bot: Pager cleared for @lena-sre. Actions: 1) arjun-eng to own postmortem, 2) add checksum alert and compaction gating, 3) customer communications finalized by CS.

arjun-eng: A few follow-ups I'll include in postmortem: exact compaction window, why node-3 persisted bad blobs after canary, and a proposal for automated repair on detection.

lena-sre: :thumbsup: Good work. I'll close this thread after the postmortem is created and customers are confirmed healed.
